question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is:** Pronounciation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is **"pronunciation,"** which refers to the way in which a word is pronounced. (उच्चारण)

 
 
• **​​For example:** Good pronunciation is essential for clear communication.
 
 
 
• A common mistake is to spell it as it sounds, with an **"o"** after the **"n,"** but the correct spelling does not include this **"o."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4". ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 **"Believe" **is spelled correctly, following the rule 'i' before 'e' except after 'c'. (मानना)

 
 
• 
 **​​For example:** She believes in working hard to achieve success.
 
 
 
 
• 
 **"Audible"** is also spelled correctly, meaning able to be heard. (सुना जा सकने वाला)

 
 
• 
 **​​For example: **The speaker's voice was barely audible at the back of the room.
 
 
 
 
• 
 **"Throat"** is spelled correctly, referring to the front part of the neck. (गला)

 
 
• 
 **​​For example:** He had a sore throat and could not speak.
